sentences.text: Le nouveau collègue a confié à Julien qu'il avait grandi orphelin chez sa tante.
sentences.en: The new colleague told Julien that he had grown up an orphan at his aunt's.
sentences.ko: 새 동료는 쥘리앵에게 고아로 이모 집에서 자랐다고 털어놨어요.

sentences.text: Manon chante l'histoire d'un orphelin élevé par des marins dans un vieux port.
sentences.en: Manon sings the story of an orphan raised by sailors in an old port.
sentences.ko: 마농은 옛 항구에서 뱃사람들 손에 자란 고아의 이야기를 노래해요.

sentences.text: Au séminaire, Julien était le cavalier de sa collègue pour la danse d'ouverture.
sentences.en: At the company retreat, Julien was his colleague's partner for the opening dance.
sentences.ko: 워크숍에서 쥘리앵은 오프닝 춤에서 동료의 파트너였어요.

sentences.text: Au bal de l'école de musique, Manon cherchait encore un cavalier.
sentences.en: At the music school ball, Manon was still looking for a dance partner.
sentences.ko: 음악 학교 무도회에서 마농은 아직 춤 파트너를 찾고 있었어요.
